newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade with activity limited by fresh incentives, brokers said on Thursday.
They said market sentiment was also depressed by a shortage of players in the market due to the uopcoming MRELB annual dinner in Kuala Lumpur on Friday.

Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slighty across the board, supported by the Yen's weakness against the dollar. But activity was dominated by position-adjustments ahead of the spot expiry on Friday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh incentives. But prices were narrowly mixed in the afternoon on some light local two-way trade amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, November RSS3 fell one cent to 123.25 U.S. cents a kg.
July/September RSS1 rose 1.25 cents to 186.00 Singapore cents (US$1.31) a kg. January TSR20 was unchanged from Wednesday's settlement of 175.00 Singapore cents (US$1.24) a kg. (US$1-S$1.41)
